run.researchNotes: Top-up 8, part 2: remaining bellwether Q2 FY27 quarter figures (EID Parry, Avanti Feeds, Kaveri Seed, Entero), plus tailwinds and risks completed to two each from bellwethers' Q2 FY27 filings and calls, company named in each. Outlook arrays are sent in full, including the items already sent, so a replace-merge loses nothing. Per-company consensus forecasts and EPS histories are logged, not sent; see searchLog for why.

quarter.source: EID Parry Q2 FY27 consolidated results (Univest, company filing); profit after tax and non-controlling interest
Avanti Feeds Q2 FY27 consolidated results filed 10-11-2026 (Univest, Multibagg)
Kaveri Seed Q2 FY27 consolidated results filed 28-10-2026 (Univest)
Entero Healthcare Q2 FY27 consolidated results filed 04-11-2026 (Univest; Arthneeti from investor presentation)

tailwinds: Bank of Baroda Research notes trading was among the sectors leading asset growth going into FY27.
Redington's Q2 FY27 India revenue rose 67% and its Technology Solutions Group revenue 91% YoY, on a shift to GPUs and premium smartphones (company results).
risks: Distribution margins are thin and working-capital intensive.
Redington's Q2 FY27 operating cash flow was -Rs 1,686 cr and free cash flow -Rs 1,871 cr as working capital rose (Q2 FY27 earnings presentation).
outlook.source: Bank of Baroda Economic Research (08-06-2026); Redington Q2 FY27 results and earnings presentation (04-11-2026, via Multibagg and Investywise)

tailwinds: The Nifty Conglomerate 50 trades at 20.6x against a 27.8x median, its 9th percentile (marketcalls, 20-11-2026).
Bajaj Holdings' share of associates' profits rose 40% to Rs 2,266.84 cr in Q2 FY27, lifting profit attributable to owners 28% (company filing).
risks: Holding-company discounts can persist regardless of the value of underlying holdings.
Grasim's Q2 FY27 consolidated net profit fell 34.7% after a Rs 767 cr pulp-mill idling charge, despite 26% revenue growth (company filing).
outlook.source: marketcalls.in NSE index valuation dashboard (20-11-2026); Bajaj Holdings Q2 FY27 results (03-11-2026, Multibagg); Grasim Q2 FY27 results (13-11-2026, Multibagg)

tailwinds: ICRA expects port cargo volume growth to continue in FY27 despite global headwinds.
GE Shipping's Q2 FY27 revenue rose 46.9% YoY, and normalised PAT excluding ship-sale gains rose 66.5% to Rs 967.66 cr (company results).
risks: ICRA notes container volumes remain exposed to geopolitical tensions and container availability.
GE Shipping's revenue fell 9% QoQ in Q2 FY27, and Rs 308 cr of its quarterly PAT came from one-off ship sales (company results).
outlook.source: ICRA Ports & Port Logistics (May-2026); GE Shipping Q2 FY27 results (06-11-2026, CompoundingAI and Multibagg)

tailwinds: ICRA cites a pick-up in Jal Jeevan Mission awards as a driver of the FY27 construction recovery.
Thermax ended Q2 FY27 with an order balance of Rs 14,250 cr, up 16% YoY, and VA Tech Wabag reported a record order book above Rs 20,000 cr (company results).
risks: Water projects depend on state government payment cycles.
Ion Exchange swung to a Q2 FY27 consolidated net loss of Rs 83 cr, and Thermax's PBT margin fell to 6.1% from 7.0% (company results).
outlook.source: ICRA Construction outlook (2026); Thermax Q2 FY27 results (05-11-2026, Multibagg); VA Tech Wabag Q2 FY27 results (05-11-2026, Investywise); Ion Exchange Q2 FY27 results (03-11-2026, Sovrenn)

risks: Themes overlap other sectors (EMS, defence, capital goods) whose valuations are already stretched.
Execution is squeezing margins: Dixon's Q2 FY27 operating margin fell 110 bp to 2.7%, and Kaynes' profit fell 61.6% on higher finance and employee costs (company results).
outlook.source: Ministry of Defence (2026); ICRA apparel outlook (Feb-2026); Dixon Q2 FY27 results (30-10-2026, Multibagg); Kaynes Q2 FY27 results (14-11-2026, Oquilia and Hans India)

tailwinds: NIIT Learning Systems' Q2 FY27 consolidated revenue rose 11% YoY to Rs 528.58 cr (company filing).
NIIT Ltd's Q2 FY27 EBITDA rose to Rs 27 mn from Rs 13 mn a year earlier, despite lower revenue (investor presentation).
risks: NIIT Ltd's Q2 FY27 revenue fell 6% YoY, which it attributed to a Rs 10 cr pullback in spending by four large global systems-integrator clients (earnings call).
NIIT Learning Systems' Q2 FY27 net profit fell 20.55% as its EBITDA margin dropped about 378 bp to 17% (company filing).
outlook.source: NIIT Ltd Q2 FY27 results and earnings call (27-10-2026, Multibagg and Arthneeti); NIIT Learning Systems Q2 FY27 results (29-10-2026, Univest and Arthneeti)
